title: Route-capability reconciliation across DWG readers, DXF projections, and geometry consumers
mode: Primary-source repository manuals, API documentation, known-issue inventories, and public issue review
scope: Reconcile open-source route capabilities by operation, format/version, and evidence layer rather than project-level support claims.
Identify safe optional comparator roles for GDAL and BRL-CAD without increasing routine validation cost.
Keep DWG container/object graph, DXF record semantics, modeler-carrier transport, B-rep interpretation, and native-consumer qualification distinct.

method.limitations: Documentation and source-tree evidence establish declared route boundaries only. No peer runtime behavior was measured, no local defect was reproduced, and current branches/docs may change; future runs must pin immutable revisions and artifacts.

sources.name: LibreDWG manual, class table, and release notes
sources.observed: The manual separates DWG decoding, DXF conversion, and GeoJSON projection; unknown classes/types may be retained as binary blobs without DXF codes, GeoJSON has documented omissions, and release notes contain version-/direction-specific writer caveats.

sources.name: GDAL DXF driver and known issues
sources.observed: The DXF route projects into OGR features, can expose unhandled raw group codes, tessellates curves, omits several style/3D/OCS semantics, and writes AutoCAD 2004 DXF. AC1027+ 3D-extensible mode exposes ASM bytes and an affine transform but does not create OGR solid geometry.

sources.name: BRL-CAD DXF conversion documentation and issue #228
sources.observed: The dxf-g documentation describes layer-aggregated geometry conversion and a millimeter default when units are absent. Open issue #228 reports a malformed POLYLINE face-index out-of-bounds read in the peer importer; it is not a libdxfrw reproduction or normative format evidence.

sources.name: ezdxf entity model, XREF limits, and export contract
sources.observed: ezdxf exposes typed DXF entities and ACIS carrier objects, but version changes do not convert unsupported features; XREF import is limited and associative HATCH relationships are not managed by the entity API. This is not a B-rep or whole-document graph oracle.

sources.name: gdsestimating/dxf-parser README
sources.observed: The project documents a typed DXF object projection with a bounded entity set rather than complete entity/object-family coverage; 3DSOLID is outside the documented typed set.

plan_impact.comparator_admission: Require an immutable route fingerprint: implementation lineage, exact artifact/revision, input format/version, operation/direction, entity/object families, options, transformations, unsupported/opaque treatment, and independent expected-value source.
plan_impact.gdal: Optional direct-DXF OGR projection check at an existing composed checkpoint only. Use raw group-code output and geometry as separate observations; AC1027+ ASM bytes/transform verify transport only.
plan_impact.brlcad_dxf_g: Conditional geometry-consumer projection for valid scratch-generated supported inputs. Account for per-layer aggregation, units, scale, and tolerance. Do not route malformed POLYLINE security controls to it while issue #228 remains unresolved.
plan_impact.acis_acds: No reviewed route closes the full DWG entity-to-AcDs-owner/key-to-payload-to-complete-B-rep-to-native-consumer chain.
plan_impact.implementation_change: No local defect, new finding, top-level subplan, dependency, fixture, test, peer runtime, native run, validation cadence change, or support promotion.

repository_state: Plan and research receipt only, in a broadly dirty shared worktree. No changes were staged or committed.
